web.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash: a detailed benchmark and capability review
web.description:
![](https://appwrite.io/images/blog/gemini-3-5-flash-deep-dive/cover.avif)

This post evaluates that claim against three data sources: Google's published model card, [Artificial Analysis](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/gemini-3-5-flash), and [Appwrite Arena](https://arena.appwrite.io/), an open-source benchmark covering 191 questions across nine Appwrite service categories.

## [Model overview](https://appwrite.io/blog/post/gemini-3-5-flash-deep-dive#model-overview)
Gemini 3.5 Flash is built on the Gemini 3 Flash reasoning foundation with explicit thinking levels that control quality, cost, and latency.

## [Google's published benchmark table](https://appwrite.io/blog/post/gemini-3-5-flash-deep-dive#googles-published-benchmark-table)
The model card lists head-to-head numbers against Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, and GPT-5.5.

The largest gain is MCP Atlas: a 21.6 point increase over Gemini 3 Flash and 5.4 points over 3.1 Pro. On MCP tool-call workloads, 3.5 Flash is Google's strongest model in the Gemini 3 series.
